description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Duration 1 minute

Choose a doorway, corridor, breach, bridge, or comparable choke point you are standing in. For the duration, enemies cannot move through it while you are conscious and in it, except by moving through your space, which requires a successful Athletics check against your Class DC. A creature three or more sizes larger than you ignores this entirely, and is usually the reason you needed the minute in the first place.
